blockers: Rights-provenance: the OpenStax source license string claims 'CC BY 4.0' but the publisher's actual terms are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (verified in the book's on-page licensing section). Correct the license string before admission; the paraphrase-only use itself is compliant.

dimensions.evidence: D and S counts in count units; count/count dimensionless with the per-1000 normalization carried by the output unit, as the translation note states. Factor 1000 is the exact printed normalization, not fitted. No scale, sign, or unit issues.

guards-inverses.evidence: Guards D>=0, S>0, D<=S; rejection cases cover D=800>S=776 (domain) and missing S. Inverse S=D*1000/q (nonzero q) verified: 12*1000/15.5=774.19, within the rounding band of true 776 as the record states; exact recovery needs the unrounded rate. q=0 singularity (S undetermined) and admissible D=0->q=0 boundary both handled. Algebraic inversion only.

reference-independence.evidence: All three references are published values verified on the live OpenStax page: worked example 12/776->~15.5, Table 45.1 rows 145/946->153.3 and 54/1000->54.0. Reviewer recomputed: 12/776*1000=15.4639 (diff 0.036 within 0.05 tolerance); 145/946*1000=153.277 (diff 0.026 within tolerance); 54/1000*1000=54.0 exact. Published oracles with documented rounding propagation.

rights-provenance.evidence: FAILED: the OpenStax source states 'distributed under CC BY 4.0 per the publisher's standard licensing', but reviewer inspection of the actual on-page licensing section shows Biology 2e uses the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike License (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), noncommercial-only with share-alike — materially different from the claimed CC BY 4.0. The record's 'exact terms section unverified' hedge does not cure the specific wrong license identifier. The proposed paraphrase-only use (short paraphrase, computed numbers, no verbatim quotation, verified by full-record read) is compliant under either license; only the license string needs correction. This is not legal clearance.

scope.evidence: Bounded to one stated age interval of one cohort life table (Table 45.1 Dall sheep, Deevey 1947); explicitly not an annualized hazard and not comparable across interval lengths without rescaling. Limitations note published values are rounded to one decimal. Clear conditional definitional scope.

source-fidelity.evidence: Formula matches Section 45.1 'Life Tables' exactly: mortality rate (per 1000, column D) = dying (column B) / surviving at interval start (column C) x 1000, with the worked 12-of-776 -> ~15.5 example. Table 45.1 rows verified verbatim: 0-0.5 yr: 54/1000->54.0; 0.5-1 yr: 145/946->153.3; 3-4 yr: 12/776->15.5. Data-adapted-from Deevey (Q. Rev. Biology 22, 1947) footnote confirmed. D/S mappings honestly flagged as local labels for columns B/C.

models.permitted_use: None pending revision: correct the OpenStax license string to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. After correction, use only as the single-interval life-table rate q=D/S*1000 per thousand alive at the interval start; not an annualized hazard.

sources.finding: Paraphrase confirmed: mortality rate per 1000 = dying during interval / surviving at its start x 1000; sheep example 12 of 776 -> ~15.5; Table 45.1 (Ovis dalli, adapted from Deevey 1947) rows 54/1000->54.0, 145/946->153.3, 12/776->15.5. On-page licensing section states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, contradicting the record's CC BY 4.0 claim.
